doc: Self-validation manifest — the loop must never merge a capability it cannot itself VALIDATE in CI. Each active capability declares HOW it is proven keyless (an e2e spec the CI e2e job runs, or a unit/degrade test the `verify` job runs). A capability whose validation needs an env the loop can't supply (an OWNER SECRET) sets requiresOwnerSecret + ownerActionId; until the owner wires the secret in CI, the self-validation tripwire (scripts/check-self-validation.mjs) goes RED and the PR can't merge. Non-secret CI envs a check needs (e.g. EMAIL_CAPTURE_DIR — a temp dir) go in requiresCiEnv so a missing one BLOCKS instead of silently skipping. status: active|planned|retired. Extend this as the app grows; the auditor + factory keep it in sync.

capabilities.summary: Signup → working dashboard (never an error screen), core navigation, pantry/cook surfaces — the outcome-asserting BUILDS!=WORKS suite.
Waitlist double-opt-in email SIDE-EFFECT integrity — submit → a real confirmation email is dispatched → retrieve it from the capture sink → follow the confirm link → confirmed (no fake success).

Server-side subscription entitlement gating + tier resolution (premium / annual / family), fail-open when the flag is off — validated keyless via unit tests (no live Stripe key needed for the entitlement logic).
The TEST-ONLY rate-limit bypass (RATE_LIMIT_DISABLED) FAILS CLOSED in a production runtime — proves abuse protection can never be silently disabled live.
The email capture sink (EMAIL_CAPTURE_DIR) FAILS CLOSED in a production runtime and the provider transport fails open with a warning when unconfigured — keyless unit-validated.
